name: Scream
label: Dischord
lede: Two brothers from the Virginia suburbs made Dischord's first full-length by a single band, toured Europe before most American hardcore bands dared, and handed a 17-year-old named Dave Grohl his first real gig.

eras.title: Rock and roll in a hardcore town
eras.text: Scream came together in Bailey's Crossroads, Virginia, and found D.C. punk through Bad Brains. Their rock and roll streak was the thing the city's hardcore bands didn't share.

years.h: Pete Stahl and his brother Franz start a band in Bailey's Crossroads
years.p: [[Pete Stahl|9241a075-b363-477a-88ba-dfa8910b0b13]] sings, [[Franz Stahl|b41d6d0a-bfd7-4927-96cf-7273a320d02a]] plays guitar and [[Skeeter Thompson|f308929f-4345-4c02-b2fe-0871c7762c8b]] plays bass. [[Kent Stax|c1e2187d-d4c7-428f-a4c8-3b4043f31591]] takes over the drums from original drummer Steve Atton not long after.
years.xp: Dischord says the band came out of Bailey's Crossroads, Virginia, and found D.C. through [[Bad Brains|e919b253-da5b-4aae-a444-6a368376a2d6]]. What set them apart, in Dischord's words, was a set of rock and roll sensibilities the city's hardcore bands didn't share.

eras.title: Dischord's first full-length, then the ocean
eras.text: Dischord had released singles, a sampler and a split LP before Scream handed it a whole album. They followed it with a second guitarist and a run of European shows that almost no American hardcore band was making yet.

years.src: Dischord: Scream, Still Screaming · Wikipedia: Scream (band)
years.h: Dischord's first whole album by one band is Still Screaming
years.p: Scream cut 17 songs at Inner Ear in 1982 with [[Ian MacKaye|c12f644b-1066-4ead-b0dd-d0c380f5cca2]], [[Eddie Janney|323dd1dd-23e4-45ce-9aa9-c5492096d604]] and Don Zientara, and Dischord put them out in 1983 as No. 9.
years.xp:
Until then Dischord had released singles, the Flex Your Head sampler and the Faith/Void split. Still Screaming was the first time the label gave a whole long-player to one band, and it was a rock and roll one.

Dischord re-cut the LP in March 2009, and it has stayed in print.

years.h: Live at Ebony Hall, Winnipeg, September 11, 1983
yt: Live at Ebony Hall, Winnipeg, September 11, 1983
Full set, Lake Braddock, Virginia, January 1986
years.h: A second guitarist arrives for This Side Up
years.p: [[Robert Lee "Harley" Davidson|01bf2142-0999-4077-8a59-11256ff80016]] joins Scream on guitar for their second album, in the studio and on stage.
years.xp: A full set filmed on January 3, 1986 at Lake Braddock Community Center in Burke, Virginia shows the five-piece line-up at work: Kent Stax on drums, Davidson on second guitar beside Franz Stahl.

years.cap: Scream at the Emma squat in Amsterdam, summer 1986
years.h: Scream cross the Atlantic before most American hardcore bands do
years.p: The band tours hard across the US, then Europe and the UK. Dischord counts them among the first American hardcore bands to make that trip.
years.xp: Dischord gives no year for the first crossing. This photo is from a squat venue in Amsterdam in the summer of 1986.

eras.title: The kid on the drums
eras.text: When Kent Stax left in 1986, Scream hired Dave Grohl, a teenager from the local scene who fibbed about his age to get the job. Four years later the band came apart on the road, and Grohl headed north to Seattle to join Nirvana.

years.src: Dischord: Scream · Wikipedia: Dave Grohl · Wikipedia: Scream (band)
years.h: Scream's new drummer is 17 and says he's older
years.p: Kent Stax leaves to start a family. [[Dave Grohl|4d5f891d-9bce-45ae-ad86-912dd27252fa]] auditions, tells the band he's older than he is so they'll take him on tour, and drops out of high school in his junior year.
years.xp:
Wikipedia puts Grohl at 17 when he joined in 1986; Dischord calls him a young local drummer. Neither says what age he told the band he was.

Footage of a full show in Regina on May 19, 1989 has Grohl at the kit.

years.h: Banging the Drum is the last Scream album with Stax
years.p: Dischord No. 25 is the band's third album and the last to carry Kent Stax on drums.
years.xp: Stax's own obituary coverage lists the first three Scream albums as his: Still Screaming, This Side Up and this one.

years.h: Grohl ends up on drums for Iggy Pop in Toronto
years.p: On a 1987 Scream tour stop in Toronto, [[Dave Grohl|4d5f891d-9bce-45ae-ad86-912dd27252fa]] sits in with [[Iggy Pop|f37b3f31-b1f8-4b88-8cb5-b34f709b17d7]] at a CD release event.

years.h: No More Censorship comes out on a reggae label
years.p: Grohl's first studio album with Scream skips Dischord and goes to RAS Records, a reggae imprint.
years.xp: Two filmed shows from 1988 have Grohl at the kit. At AJZ in Bielefeld, Germany, the band plays Choke Word; in Newcastle on April 3 they play God Squad.

years.h: An Alzey, Germany show from spring 1990 becomes a live album
years.p: Scream record the night on their spring European tour and release it as Your Choice Live Series Vol. 10.

years.src: Wikipedia: Dave Grohl · Wikipedia: Scream (band) · Alan Cross
yt: Full show, Apocalypse Club, Toronto, July 28, 1990
years.h: Skeeter Thompson quits mid-tour and Scream end up in Los Angeles
years.p: Thompson leaves in 1990 and the band falls apart. Grohl, broke and stranded in L.A., phones Buzz Osborne of the [[Melvins|9ccfbc94-a4f4-42f7-b6f5-d903ab77cccb]].
years.xp:
Pete and Franz Stahl stayed in North Hollywood and started Wool.

On an earlier West Coast run, Grohl had become friends with the Melvins, and Osborne had brought [[Kurt Cobain|3c9b356d-d1db-4f4e-a7a3-2d00c1d70255]] and [[Krist Novoselic|ac05e29f-0561-4445-bb26-5562d2389531]] to see Scream play. With the band suddenly gone, Grohl phoned Osborne, who told him [[Nirvana|5b11f4ce-a62d-471e-81fc-a69a8278c7da]] needed a drummer and passed along their number.

Grohl moved to Seattle and joined Nirvana that year.

eras.title: One more record, one more Christmas
eras.text: Fumble came out three years after the band stopped, with Grohl, by then in Nirvana, on drums. One-off reunions followed, including a December 1996 show at the Black Cat in D.C.

years.h: Grohl writes and sings Gods Look Down on Fumble
years.p: Scream record Fumble at Inner Ear with Eli Janney producing. It's Dischord No. 83, and it arrives three years after the breakup.
years.xp: By the time it was out, Grohl was in Nirvana. The Scream line-up that made it went back out on the road that summer.

years.h: Summer tour of North America for Fumble
years.p: Pete Stahl, Franz Stahl, Skeeter Thompson and Grohl go back out as Scream.

years.h: Zack de la Rocha sings with Scream at the Dragonfly
years.p: Scream play a one-off reunion show in Los Angeles in August, and [[Rage Against the Machine|3798b104-01cb-484c-a3b0-56adc6399b80]] singer de la Rocha joins them on stage.

years.h: Christmas show at the Black Cat, recorded for Torque
years.p: Scream play a holiday reunion in Washington, D.C. on December 28, with Kent Stax back on drums. Live at the Black Cat comes out in 1998 on Torque Records.
years.xp: Dischord notes Stax returned as Scream's drummer for the night.

eras.title: The original four, and a last goodbye
eras.text: The original line-up came back and stayed, with Grohl now hosting them at Studio 606 instead of drumming. Their final album, DC Special, put six decades of D.C. music on one record and arrived weeks after the death of drummer Kent Stax.

years.cap: Scream on stage at Kleiner Klub, Saarbrucken, Germany, January 2012
years.h: The original four share a stage again at the Black Cat
years.p: Pete Stahl, Franz Stahl, Skeeter Thompson and Kent Stax play as Scream in Washington, D.C. on December 20.
years.xp: The line-up held. By the winter of 2012 they were back on the road in Europe.

years.cap: Pete Stahl at Kleiner Klub, Saarbrucken, Germany, January 2012
years.h: Scream play the 9:30 Club's 30th birthday
years.p: An ad hoc Scream line-up plays the club's anniversary celebration in Washington, D.C. on May 31.

years.h: Grohl hosts his old band at Studio 606
years.p: John Lousteau records seven songs live with the original line-up at Grohl's L.A. studio, where their former drummer now runs the room.

years.cap: Scream live at Kleiner Klub, Saarbrucken, Germany, January 2012
years.h: Back to Europe, more than twenty years on
years.p: Scream tour Europe for the first time since 1990.
years.xp: The winter 2012 run is one of the tours Wikipedia lists for the reunited band. The photos above are from a show at Kleiner Klub in Saarbrucken, with Kent Stax still on the drum stool.

years.h: No More Censorship is back in print
years.p: Scream's 1988 album, Grohl's first studio record with the band, is reissued on April 27.

q: Kent is the original heartbeat of Scream.
years.h: Kent Stax dies at 61
years.p: The band called him irreplaceable, and a fisherman, carpenter and train enthusiast. He had been fighting metastatic cancer.
years.xp:
Stax joined not long after the band formed and played on Still Screaming, This Side Up and Banging the Drum. The band's statement used his given name, Bennett Kent Stacks. He came back for the reunions, played in other bands including The Suspects and the Daryl Davis Band, and was married to his wife Andrea for 40 years.

His death came days after Scream announced DC Special. Grohl dedicated Everlong to him at a Foo Fighters show, Consequence reported.

years.h: Jerry Busher takes the drum stool
years.p: A longtime D.C. drummer who also plays on DC Special, Busher replaces Kent Stax.

years.src: Dischord: Scream, DC Special · Wikipedia: Scream (band)
years.h: Six decades of D.C. music show up for DC Special
years.p: Don Zientara records Scream's last album at Inner Ear shortly before the studio's eviction, with guests including [[Dave Grohl|4d5f891d-9bce-45ae-ad86-912dd27252fa]], [[Ian MacKaye|c12f644b-1066-4ead-b0dd-d0c380f5cca2]], [[Brian Baker|1fd36abf-e43c-4b01-820b-d7280cc27ea5]], [[Joe Lally|62046ffd-7d76-476b-bee5-b281b7575c6c]] and Amy Pickering. It's Dischord No. 194.
years.xp:
Scream built the record as a history lesson: the band invited its whole music community in to weave the story of Washington music into the story of Scream. It was also one of the last records Zientara made at Inner Ear, forty years after he helped produce Still Screaming.

Dischord's official video for Sha La La was made by Brendan Canty.

years.h: Andrew Black follows Busher on drums
years.p: Black takes over after Jerry Busher's stint, per Wikipedia.
